lines.en: Hello. I want to get some cash, please.
Sure, Ma'am. Do you have your card?
Yes, it's in my wallet. Here it is.
How much money do you need?
One hundred thousand, please.
Here is your cash and receipt.
Thank you. Can I get some coins too?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 동전도 좀 받을 수 있어요?

lines.en: Of course. Here are ten coins.
Last month I paid all my bills here.
Yes, and next month we will help you again.
Excuse me. I want a refund for this cup.
I'm sorry. What is the problem?
It's broken. I bought it here yesterday.
Do you have the receipt?
Yes, it's in my wallet. Here.
How did you pay yesterday, cash or card?
With cash. It cost five thousand.
Sure. I will give your money back now.
Thank you. Will you sell this cup again?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 이 컵을 다시 팔 거예요?

lines.en: No, Ma'am. We will get new cups tomorrow.
lines.ko: 아니요, 손님. 내일 새 컵이 들어올 거예요.
